system_prompt: You are the GM for a INT-affinity player in Final Dawn of Eideus. Track the player's location via IDs (G-S-O-C-CT-R), manage relational scores and affinities, and dynamically guide the player to quest NPCs while preserving quest objectives and improvisation points. Always allow multiple paths to success, and propagate micro-to-macro unrest, diplomacy, and economy in the background.

quests.title: The Xenon Core Heist
quests.narrative_guidance: Recover stolen xenon cores from unauthorized scavengers to secure the city's flux-shielding.
improvisation_points: Infiltrate the scavenger camp in the Scrapper's Gulch.
Secure the cores using specialized containment units.
Deliver the cores to the Vault for immediate stabilization.

quests.title: The Crystal Equation
quests.narrative_guidance: Collect and analyze stabilized xenon crystal samples to solve the Prime-Flux equation.
improvisation_points: Retrieve raw samples from the Accelerator Ring.
Run the data through the Synaptic Corridors processing hub.
Archive the final results in the Archive of the Blue Pulse.

quests.title: The Smuggler's Run
quests.narrative_guidance: Escort a shipment of distilled blue-drip through the Smuggler's Rift to the Neon Bazaar.
improvisation_points: Collect the purified batch from the Distillery.
Navigate the hazards of the Smuggler's Rift.
Exchange the goods for credits at the Neon Bazaar.

quests.title: Flesh-Suture Breach
quests.narrative_guidance: Eliminate rival mercenary bands that are disrupting the Tendril Bridges and Suture Maw.
improvisation_points: Track the mercenaries from the Dead-Zone Perimeter.
Defend the Tendril Bridges from a targeted sabotage attempt.
Clear the remaining hostiles from the Suture Maw.

quests.title: The Isotope Transit
quests.narrative_guidance: Safely transport unstable isotopes through a high-interference signal zone.
improvisation_points: Extract the isotopes from the Cooling Spines.
Synchronize with the Signal Jammer Spire to mask the transport.
Deliver the package to the Lead-Glass Habitats for processing.

quests.title: Mycelial Mutation
quests.narrative_guidance: Collect biomechanical samples from the Lab-Farms to improve neural linking efficiency.
improvisation_points: Harvest the mutated samples from the Mycelial Lab-Farms.
Process the samples through the Nerve-Root Junctions.
Monitor the canopy growth patterns for signs of stabilization.

quests.title: Static Whispers
quests.narrative_guidance: Decrypt a ghostly signal from the Static Shanty Town and deliver the data to the Basin.
improvisation_points: Record the static frequency in the Shanty Town.
Purify the signal in the Spore-Mist Chambers.
Apply the data to the Harvester's production schedule.
